MOM28, REV7, MAX, volume shock, taker flow (0035/0040/0047)

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user.
universe: exactly ADR 0047/0096/0097 (U50 by 30-day mean quote volume >= 2M USDT, >=60 bars, cut-off bar i-2)

segments.rebalance: every 14 days on the Monday grid (anchors 2021-03-01, 2024-08-19); trade at open of day i; weights drift; real funding

trials.AF1_AGGFUND_TIMING_U50: F = median over U50 names of the 7-day summed funding at cut; long all U50 names equally (gross 1) when F <= median of the same F series over the previous 180 days (computed at each past day cut-179..cut with that day's U50 = current U50 names), else flat
trials.AE1_ALT_VS_ETH_U50: A = EW cumulative return of U50 names other than ETHUSDT over cut-27..cut, E = ETHUSDT return same days; if A > E: long U50 ex-ETH equally (gross 0.5) and short ETHUSDT 0.5; else the reverse; flat if ETHUSDT not eligible
trials.MT1_MOM_TURNOVER_U50: among U50: mom = close[cut]/close[cut-27]-1, tchg = ln(mean qv cut-6..cut / mean qv cut-34..cut-7); long names in the top half of mom AND bottom half of tchg, short names in the bottom half of mom AND top half of tchg; equal weight 0.5/n per side
trials.SK1_REALSKEW_U50: skewness of daily close-to-close returns over cut-89..cut (>= 60); quintile long-short, long the LOWEST
trials.RV1_QUIET_REVERSAL_U50: among U50 names whose volume shock ln(mean qv cut-6..cut / mean qv cut-34..cut-7) is below the U50 median: 7-day return quintile (K = floor(n_sub/5)) long the LOWEST, short the HIGHEST
trials.PS1_PERP_SPOT_GAP_U50: mean over cut-6..cut of perp close / spot close - 1 (>= 5 days, spot pair as ADR 0096 mapping); quintile long-short, long the LOWEST

cost: ADR 0041 calibrated cost 'cal' decides; cal_x2, cal_tail_x2 conditions; cost0 reference
decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096/0097 (S1 SR > expected max of 6 null trials, alpha t >= 2 vs EW U50, both S1 halves > 0, S2 > 0.5, S1 > 0 under cal_x2 and cal_tail_x2); DSR N=6 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 over the 6 S1 series reported
power_note_written_before_results: about 58 S1 rebalances over 2.2 years; MDE at 80% (Bonferroni 0.05/6) about 2.2; cumulative-N null max about 2.6
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +6 regardless.
